in_hebrew.name: Farny
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Farny הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name Pharnus, meaning 'fern' or 'fern's child'. In Greek mythology, Pharnus was a hero who saved the god Dionysus from a lion. Farny can be considered a name of strength and protection.
